ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_MIRROR_IMAGE.title: Mirror Image
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_MIRROR_IMAGE.descrip: Your phantom doubles (max 8). Cards you Exhaust are stored into free mirrors. Each instance of unblocked damage you take kills the newest-loaded mirror (loaded ones before empty ones): it plays its stored card at the enemy that broke it (else a random enemy), then puts the card into the exhaust pile; a dying empty mirror instead deals 2 damage and grants 2 Block.
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_FIRST_MOVE.title: First Move
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_FIRST_MOVE.descripti: Triggers only if this is the first card you play this turn.
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_TRANSMUTE.title: Transmute
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_TRANSMUTE.descriptio: [gold]Transform[/gold] a card. At the start of your next turn, [gold]transform[/gold] it into what it was before that [gold]transform[/gold].
